\newcommand{\figcapLatencyWarm}{Warm median verification latency against $N$, medium profile, log scale: arms A (aggregate BLS), A-ind (individual BLS), C (Ed25519) and C-batch (Ed25519, batch verification). \newcommand{\figcapPrefixHit}{Median latency of a prefix-cache hit against $N$, medium profile, log scale: arm B (BLS with pairing and prefix caches) and arm D (Ed25519 with a prefix cache). Points are pooled medians of three runs; error bars are the range of the three runs' medians.}
\newcommand{\figcapBytes}{Chain size in bytes against $N$, medium profile: arms A, A-ind and C. The dashed line marks the break-even: A's chain is smaller than C's from $N = 2$. Sizes are means over 20 sampled chains and do not vary between runs, so there are no error bars.}
\newcommand{\figcapRatios}{The frozen plan's verdict ratios: latency of the aggregating arm over its Ed25519 counterpart against $N$: A/C (warm) and B/D (warm+prefix), in the small, medium and large profiles, log scale. The line marks equal latency, and the band the frozen plan's $\pm10\%$ margin of no material difference; every run's ratio lies above it, so aggregation is not a net benefit at any point. Points are ratios of pooled medians; error bars are the range of the three runs' ratios of medians.}
